[EN] Obviously, my letters home to my folks are a tad embellished. I don't think they'd be as proud if I wrote that I was guarding a pass that almost no one ever uses.
[ES] Obviamente, mis cartas a casa para los míos están un poco adornadas. No creo que estarían tan orgullosos si escribiera que estoy custodiando un paso que casi nadie usa jamás.
